Hi Jin,

Thanks for applying to the Backend Infrastructure Engineer role at Redwood Inference — really enjoyed reading through your background at BrightScale. I wanted to get a quick 20-minute phone screen on the calendar to cover your experience and a few technical touchpoints.

A couple of logistics up front: I see you’re based in Seoul (KST, UTC+9) per your resume. Our interviewers are PDT-based, so I wanted to propose times with a 24-hour buffer before we lock an invite (we sometimes need to shift interviewer slots). If you can confirm one of these windows, I’ll send a calendar invite (ICS) and include a 24-hour cancellation buffer so nothing is finalized until both sides confirm.

Available windows (all in your local time — KST):
- Wed, 26 Jun — 09:00–09:30 KST (23:00–23:30 PDT previous day)
- Thu, 27 Jun — 11:00–11:30 KST (01:00–01:30 PDT)
- Fri, 28 Jun — 08:00–08:30 KST (22:00–22:30 PDT previous day)

If none of these work, tell me your top two 30-minute windows next week and I’ll try to match. Please also confirm the best phone number to reach you and whether you prefer Zoom or a phone call. I’ve attached the resume you uploaded for quick reference.

Thanks — looking forward to connecting.

Best,
Chloe Martin

Redwood Inference
